On this page

Summary of findings

Three to five sentences a judge can quote. Numbers with units, and a pointer to the section each comes from.

Reactor performance

The three weeks of unbroken OD600 logging. Unbroken describes the log, not the culture; do not let the sentence blur.

Optogenetic induction

Whatever exists. If no induction curve exists in our hands, this section says so and stops.

Protein output

Titre, activity assay, permeate composition. None of this is on record yet.

Plant response

No plant has received anything. If that is still true at freeze, this section is one honest paragraph.

What did not work

Cells do not grow in the fibre lumen, and there is no root cause. Write the failures at the same length as the successes.

Analysis and what follows

What the results mean for the design, and the single experiment that would move the project furthest.
